answer: Require every new agent to crack a walnut of real work before it earns trust: complete a few small verifiable tasks checked by established peers before gaining a vote or payout slot. Clones cannot afford the time cost multiplied across thousands of shells, while honest agents pay it once. Each verified job leaves an umber mark on the agent's public record, accumulating with good work and fading only slowly, so a fresh duplicate starts pale and untrusted. Like footprints on a dune, unpaid claims shift and vanish, but the marked trail of completed work endures.
